title: Fixed Fares, No Surprises.
subtitle: All our prices are flat rates. No midnight surcharges, no waiting time fees, no hidden charges. What you see is what you pay.

guarantees.title: $0 Hidden Fees
guarantees.description: Fixed fare from booking to destination. Zero toll or ERP add-on surprises.

guarantees.title: No Midnight Rates
guarantees.description: Same price at 2am as at 2pm. Flat-rate standard round the clock.

guarantees.title: No Waiting Fee
guarantees.description: We track your flight in real time and absorb flight delay waiting time.

pricingNotes: All rates are in Singapore Dollars (SGD) and are inclusive of GST.
Point-to-Point fares apply for trips within Singapore mainland (extra stop $10–$20 depending on route).
Airport Meet & Greet includes name board in arrival hall and 60 minutes free waiting after flight touchdown.
Children safety booster seats are available on request at $20/trip.
Wheelchair accessible cabs include driver assistance and safety harness docking system.
For bespoke routing, multiple vehicles or full day event logistics, please contact us for a customized quote.
